result.label: bug
result.what_to_change: Give error toasts an assertive, non-dismissing live region: use a separate container (or role="alert"/aria-live="assertive") for item.kind === "error" so they're announced immediately, and skip/disable the setTimeout auto-dismiss in the Toast component when item.kind is "error" so they stay until the user dismisses them.
result.evidence: Toast.tsx renders all toasts inside a single div with role="status" aria-live="polite", and the Toast component always starts a setTimeout(() => onDismiss(item.id), AUTO_DISMISS_MS) regardless of item.kind, so error toasts are announced politely and auto-dismissed after 5 seconds just like success/info toasts.

not_searched: other components that might also invoke toast.show for error paths (e.g. ExportButton.tsx usage), i18n strings file

text: Done. I identified `src/components/Toast.tsx` as the responsible file: it uses a single `aria-live="polite"` region for all toast kinds and applies the same 5-second auto-dismiss timer regardless of whether the toast is an error, which matches the accessibility bug described in issue-4413.

input.title: Make error toasts assertive and non-auto-dismissing
input.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error toasts (item.kind === "error") should be announced via an assertive live region (e.g. a separate container or role="alert"/aria-live="assertive") instead of sharing the single role="status" aria-live="polite" container used for all toasts. Also, the setTimeout auto-dismiss should be skipped/disabled for error toasts so they remain visible until the user dismisses them, rather than disappearing after AUTO_DISMISS_MS like success/info toasts.
